description: Boeing 737-281 c/n 20562 (l/n 293), first flown 22 March 1972 for All Nippon Airways as JA8416, later LV-WSY (Austral/Aerolíneas Argentinas) and CC-CSK with Aerolíneas del Sur/Air Comet Chile, withdrawn October 2008 and sold at a customs auction in October 2012 to the Motel Ensueño chain; trucked from Santiago and placed beside the Concón-Viña del Mar road in December 2012 as a motel attraction (modocharlie.com). Visible from the road; presence after 2012 not confirmed.
